proposals.mechanism: Overnight highs and lows concentrate resting liquidity before the RTH open. A sweep followed by fast reclaim suggests the breakout side did not attract continuation flow; trapped breakout participants and stop-outs can fuel a reversal back into the overnight range.

When NQ stretches beyond VWAP by at least 15 ticks but less than 85 ticks, momentum exhaustion is faded. Rejection of the extremes leads to a mean reversion trade aiming for a return to the volume-weighted average price.
